newsitem.title: USA: Latam Brady spreads widen, but Ecuador outperforms.
newsitem.headline: Latam Brady spreads widen, but Ecuador outperforms.

text.p: Latin American Brady bond spreads widened between five to 10 basis points on Friday, except Ecuador debt which outperformed U.S. Treasuries despite cool market reception to its $500 million Eurobond new issue.
Pushing Brady yields lower versus governments was continued strong supply out of Argentina, Brazil and Venezuela and growing doubts that Treasuries can sustain recent gains.
"In general we've underperformed Treasuries across the board because of dealer supply and skepticism of Treasuries," said one dealer at a U.S. bank.
